body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
Stablecoin market cap holds near $301B as Circle backs stricter GENIUS Act rules while Tether's El Salvador base keeps USDT outside the U.S. audit framework.
Stablecoin News
Hong Kong dollar stablecoin HKDAP set to launch
A Standard Chartered-led venture's HKD-pegged stablecoin could begin trading as early as today, one of the first HKD stablecoins issued under Hong Kong's new regulatory framework.
Tether's USAT goes live on Celo
Tether deployed its GENIUS Act-aligned USAT stablecoin on Celo with native mint, burn, and gas support, its second network beyond Ethereum mainnet.
Revolut users rush out of USDT before delisting
USDT withdrawals hit $855M in a week and $2B in a month on Revolut as clients exit ahead of the platform's USDT delisting on August 31.
Circle backs tougher stablecoin oversight under GENIUS Act
Circle told the OCC it supports requiring only licensed entities to issue stablecoins, sharpening the compliance contrast with offshore issuer Tether.
Hacking & Security Incidents
AFX-powered bridge exploit drains $24M on Arbitrum
Attackers compromised private keys from five validators to hit quorum and drain roughly $24.15M in USDC, converting it to ETH in a single wallet.
H1 2026 sets record for crypto hacks: $1.1B stolen
Blockaid's first-half report counted 212 verified exploits across protocols, wallets, and infrastructure, the worst half-year on record despite fewer, more surgical attacks.
Verus Ethereum Bridge hacked a second time
An attacker siphoned about $7.54M from the Verus Ethereum Bridge on July 23, the bridge's second breach this year.
North Korea tied to npm wallet-drainer supply-chain attack
Amazon linked last year's hijack of npm packages debug and chalk to North Korean actors; a phished maintainer let a wallet-draining script reach 18+ packages with 2B+ weekly downloads.
